name: Russia
description: Follow Russia, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: U.S. Diesel Prices Set New High
changes.summary: Because of the war in Iran, the cost has climbed past the record it reached in 2022 after Russia’s full-scale invasion of Ukraine.

changes.title: After Fighting Russia Fiercely, He Wants to Forge Ukraine’s Path to Peace
changes.summary: Kyrylo Budanov, a decorated soldier and former military spy chief, advocates a negotiated settlement. Talks are expected to resume this month.

changes.title: Kushner and Witkoff to Go to Russia and Ukraine to Revive Peace Talks
changes.summary: Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff’s trip to meet with the countries’ presidents comes at a precarious moment in the Ukraine conflict.

changes.title: Russian drone strikes Ukraine security service headquarters as U.S. talks on the war are expected
changes.summary: The air war between Russia and Ukraine has intensified as the conflict stretches toward five years since Moscow's invasion of its neighbor.

changes.title: Russia intensifies attacks on Ukraine's capital
changes.summary: In Ukraine, a week of near-continuous Russian attacks is upending the lives of residents in Kyiv and its suburbs.

changes.title: Bessent Blames Ukraine for High Energy Prices
changes.summary: After meeting with Russia’s finance minister, the Treasury secretary said Ukraine’s attacks on Russian oil infrastructure were contributing to a global energy shock driven mainly by the U.S. war with Iran.

changes.title: Inside a Ukrainian maternity ward as Russian strikes intensify
changes.summary: As Russia ramps up strikes on Ukrainian cities, one underground maternity ward is allowing women to deliver babies safely amid a brutal war. NBC News' Richard Engel went inside.

changes.title: For Russia and Ukraine, an Escalating Spiral With No End in Sight
changes.summary: Each side is using missiles and drones to try to pound the other into giving up, breeding ceaseless human suffering. But there is no sign that either country’s determination will weaken.

changes.title: Attacks in Black Sea Threaten to Strangle Global Grain Supply
changes.summary: Strikes on ports and vessels by both Russia and Ukraine have left farmers facing ruin and could cause another worldwide food shock.

changes.title: China or the U.S.? Two Meetings Offer Competing Showcases of Global Power.
changes.summary: As Xi Jinping gathered with the leaders of Russia and Iran, Europe challenged the Trump administration at the G20, offering a split-screen view of a changing world.
